notes: Cats and dogs on ACC’s at-risk list must leave the shelter quickly or may be euthanised. On each animal’s page on the list there are two buttons. Press "Reserve" to adopt it yourself: it goes into a cart for 15 minutes, and you check out at the top right and pay the deposit by card. Press "Pre-Screener Form" to foster or adopt through one of ACC’s approved rescue groups (ACC calls them New Hope partners): it needs a Google sign-in, and then contact rescue groups yourself as well. New animals are posted Sunday, Tuesday and Thursday at 6 PM; each posting closes at noon two days later. Website trouble: adopt@nycacc.org. The guide "Save an animal from the NYC shelter’s urgent list" has every step and ready-made messages.

change_log.note: A reviewer pointed out that the record was written for rescues rather than for the public, and did not link to the application at all. The two links someone actually needs — which animals need placing now, and the form that says you have a home — are now first, and the pre-screener says up front that it wants a Google sign-in, because finding that out mid-deadline wastes the time that matters.
